entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this jersey I bought, and your website is useless. This is absolutely ridiculous!
I certainly apologize for the wait and for any frustration with the website. I can definitely help you with a return. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
The issue is it's the wrong size! It's way too tight. I can't even ride in this thing. I need an exchange or a refund, and I need it now. If you can't handle this, put a manager on the phone.
I understand completely, and there's no need for a manager; I am empowered to resolve this for you. I just need to pull up your order. Can I get your name or order number?
Fine. The name is Alex Peterson. But you better fix this, or I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Tech jersey, delivered about 24 days ago. I also see you're a VIP member with us, so thank you for your continued loyalty. Let me just confirm the policy.
Okay, looks great. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that exchange for a different size or a full refund. Which would you prefer?
Oh. It's... within 90 days? The last company I dealt with was a nightmare. Uh, an exchange would be great, I just need a size up.

Not a problem at all. I've just processed the exchange for the larger size. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label for the jersey that was too tight. And for the trouble today, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account as a thank you for being a VIP customer.
Wow. A $50 credit? Okay, that's... that's actually really good service. I wasn't expecting that. Thank you, Charlie. I appreciate you taking care of this so fast.
Of course, Alex. We want to make sure you have gear that fits perfectly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You really turned this around. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and enjoy the new jersey when it arrives!
